**Hello!** Welcome to my *Level* of the internet!

I am a senior health research analyst in the [Government Resource Center](https://grc.osu.edu/) at the Ohio State University, where I specialize in designing and developing data products that help transform complex public health and survey data into actionable insights. My interests include data visualization, R Shiny development, accessibility, and the design choices that shape how people experience information. I'm always looking for opportunities to learn, experiment, and develop tools that communicate data more effectively.

Before joining The Ohio State University in my current role, I earned a Master of Public Administration from Ohio University's Voinovich School of Leadership and Public Service (2024). During my graduate studies, I worked as a Graduate Research Assistant, supporting a range of data analytics and visualization projects. I also earned a Bachelor of Science in Public Health from the University of Toledo (2023).

Outside of Positron, I play adult beginner hockey, figure skate, spend my summers sailing on the Great Lakes, own a precious but patience-testing grey tabby named Pesto, and love to cross stitch!
